title: coefficient-mass: papers and executable checks on the coefficient mass of polynomial multiples
description: Eight CC BY 4.0 papers on coefficient order statistics and logarithmic coefficient mass of polynomial multiples with prescribed roots, with MIT-licensed exact-arithmetic checks in Python and Lean 4 formalizations.
notes: Dual licensing: paper sources and PDFs are CC BY 4.0; software, tests and Lean sources are MIT licensed.
